label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y todas las estacas al mishkán y al atrio alrededor de bronce.
spanish: Y todas las estacas al tabernáculo y al atrio alrededor, de bronce.
grammarChanges: Translated mishkán to the Spanish common noun tabernáculo (H4908 is a common noun, not a locked proper name).
Added a comma before 'de bronce' so bronze predicates estacas (the pegs), not 'alrededor', removing the unmarked-de misattachment.
